title: --cred returns cred_field_missing — without a field choice it types password
symptom: web type · app type --cred end with cred_field_missing ("'<name>' has no 'password' value")
cause: Without --cred-field, --cred types the password field. You meant to fill the username box, or that credential lacks the field. The response's fields lists the fields that exist
fix: For the username box: launch_cli.py web type --selector <box> --cred <name> --cred-field account
If the field really is missing, get the value from the user and fill it with cred set (do not write the value yourself)
